The landed player_map.json starts empty ({schemaVersion: 1, players: []}): no verified Yahoo-to-ESPN entries exist yet, and an unmapped Yahoo starter stays unmatched rather than guessed. Populating it is data work for a later slice.

A profile holding a lower-revision alert matches even when no starter is concerned (starters=[]), so panel/policy can revise the stale alert; lineups are never deleted, so every alert holder appears in the Lineups scan.
